title: APPLESEED Example Dataset
description: Longitudinal EEG recordings from 13 infants collected at 4, 8, and 12 months of age, with test-retest reliability assessed through two sessions within one week at 4 months. The complete dataset comprises 48 recording sessions, including 11 infants with all four sessions and 2 infants with reliability sessions only. It was used to develop and validate the APPLESEED automated preprocessing pipeline for estimating scale-wise entropy from pediatric EEG, and is provided as an example dataset.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from infants at 4 months (two sessions within one week to assess test-retest reliability), 8 months, and 12 months of age. A channel location file and bin file for analysis are included in the code directory.
